title: Basic Vowels
description: Let's learn 5 basic vowels that form the foundation of Hangeul

content.title: Vowels Made with 3 Basic Strokes
content.description: Hangeul vowels are made with 3 basic strokes
content.additional_info:
・(dot), ㅡ(horizontal line), ㅣ(vertical line)
You can make all vowels with these three elements!

content.instruction: Let's learn the basic vowels one by one
content.subtitle: Tap each vowel to hear the pronunciation and see the mouth shape

items.name: 아
items.tip: Place a dot ・ on the right side of the vertical line ㅣ. This is the most basic vowel in Hangeul!

items.name: 어
items.tip: Opposite of ㅏ, place a dot ・ on the left side of the vertical line ㅣ. Open your mouth less than ㅏ.

items.name: 오
items.tip: Place a dot ・ below the horizontal line ㅡ. Pronounce it with rounded lips.

items.name: 우
items.tip: Opposite of ㅗ, place a dot ・ above the horizontal line ㅡ. Round your lips smaller than ㅗ.

items.name: 이
items.mouth_tip: Spread your mouth sideways like smiling
items.tip: The simplest vowel made with just one vertical line. Spread your mouth sideways like when you smile!

content.question: Listen to the sound and find the correct vowel

answer.explanation: This is the '아' sound made by opening your mouth wide

content.question: Listen to the sound and find the correct vowel

answer.explanation: This is the '오' sound made by rounding your lips

content.question: Listen to the sound and find the correct vowel

answer.explanation: This is the '이' sound made by spreading your mouth sideways

content.question: Listen to the sound and find the correct vowel

answer.explanation: This is the '어' sound made by opening your mouth slightly

content.question: Listen to the sound and find the correct vowel

answer.explanation: This is the '우' sound made by rounding your lips more

content.question: Which vowel is made with ㅣ + ・(right)?

answer.explanation: When there's a dot on the right side of the vertical line, it's 'ㅏ'

content.title: Basic Vowels Mastered!
content.message: You've learned 5 basic vowels! Ready to learn more vowels? 🎉
